jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
jobs.description:
Join  Apaleo  and shape the future of hospitality tech   
 Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 
 If you’re driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you. 
  About the role  
 You’ll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform’s technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It’s a small team, so you’ll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to. 
 This is a high-ownership seat. You’ll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there. 
 We don’t run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn’t the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you’ll fit right in. 

  What you’ll be up to   
 
 Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
 Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing. 
 Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along. 
 Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering. 
 Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably. 
 Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
 Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards. 
 Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software. 
 
  Some of the challenges waiting for you   
 You’ll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions. 
 
 Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database. 
 Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
 Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform. 
 Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level. 
 
  What you’ll bring to the team   
 
 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion. 
 Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
 Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you’ve used. 
 Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
 Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
 Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don’t have a dedicated QA function. 
 A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had. 
 Fluent English. 
 
  Nice to have   
 
 Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
 Experience setting up infra

jobs.title: Multigres Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
Supabase  is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. 
 We're looking for an engineer to own the deployment and operational infrastructure of Multigres, our distributed Postgres platform. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the Multigres Operator, ensuring reliable cloud deployments, and creating the tooling that powers our Kubernetes-based infrastructure. 

 What You’ll Be Responsible for: 
 
 
  Build and maintain the Multigres Operator  - Maintain our Go-based Kubernetes operator that orchestrates distributed Postgres deployments 
 
 
  Architect cloud deployment infrastructure  - Design and implement robust deployment patterns for EKS and other Kubernetes platforms 
 
 
  Manage storage and networking layers  - Work with CSI drivers, persistent volumes, and cross-cloud networking to ensure data reliability and connectivity 
 
 
  Develop deployment tooling  - Create internal tools and automation for provisioning, scaling, and managing Multigres clusters 
 
 
  Ensure operational excellence  - Build monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic capabilities into the deployment layer 
 
 
  Collaborate across teams  - Work with database engineers, SRE, and product teams to deliver seamless deployment experiences 
 
 
  You Might Be a Good Fit If You have:  
 
 
  Strong systems programming skills  - Proficiency in Go and experience building production-grade operators or controllers 
 
 
  Deep Kubernetes expertise  - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, custom resources, and cloud-managed Kubernetes services (EKS, GKE, AKS) 
 
 
  Database operations knowledge  - Understanding of database deployment patterns, backup/restore, replication, and high availability 
 
 
  Distributed systems experience  - Familiarity with consensus protocols, failure scenarios, and designing for resilience 
 
 
  Cloud infrastructure background  - Experience with cloud-native deployment tooling, IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), and cloud provider APIs 
 
 
  Production operations mindset  - Track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems 
 
 
 Nice to Have: 
 
 
 Experience with CSI storage drivers and storage orchestration in Kubernetes 
 
 
 Knowledge of cross-cloud networking tools like Cilium, Istio, or similar service mesh technologies 
 
 
 Prior work with sharded query serving systems like Vitess 
 
 
 Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects 
 
 
  What We Offer  
 
 
  Fully Remote  
 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. 
 
 
  ESOP  
 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. 
 
 
  Tech Allowance  
 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. 
 
 
  Health Benefits  
 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. 
 
 
  Annual Off-Sites  
 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. 
 
 
  Flexible Work  
 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. 
 
 
  Professional Development  
 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. 

 
 
  About the Team  
 Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
